title: HHHusher mic setups
description: A dark full-bleed photo section with a column on the left: a small two-line heading, a list of numbered setups in mono capitals with grey index squares (the chosen and hovered ones turn yellow), the chosen setup's paragraph and a yellow button. Window-tall on phones, photo-shaped (1.49) on desktop. Rows fade in one after another as it enters; a newly chosen paragraph fades in.
notes: always dark (wraps itself in .dark); a left scrim keeps the text readable over any photo
one media slot for the section, or one per setup
choosing a setup needs JavaScript (hydrate: visible); without it the first stays chosen
name: hhhusher-setups
